Select compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Join compound_records on molregno. Join docs on doc_id. Join activities on record_id. Join assays on assay_id. Join target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2973 and standard_type IC50. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
